posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
I understand your concern, that is why we decided to put Motivation on top of each qs, so even if you are not familiar with the concepts, you can study that and get some basic idea (along with man pages etc). But seems like it was more of an issue for some .

Fibonacci is a simple question though, you do not need recursion for that.

read n
a=1
b=1
for i in $(seq $n); do
  ((c=a+b))
  echo $a
  a=$b
  b=$c
done

Screenshot 2025-08-21 at 10.01.45458×584 51.2 KB

Yes this will not work for large n as @24f3004979 mentioned, this is not logical issue but because int (32 bits) cannot store such large numbers. That is fine and expected, the inputs wont have big n.
